messages.content:
Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "255", "observation": "A piano plays a gentle melody while a soft, continuous hissing sound is audible in the background."}, {"id": "270", "observation": "A piano plays a slow, melancholic melody over the continuous sound of rain."}, {"id": "285", "observation": "A loud, sustained electronic tone plays, followed by a sharp, high-pitched electronic beep."}, {"id": "300", "observation": "A person speaks, followed by a toilet flush and a brief musical jingle."}, {"id": "315", "observation": "A low-frequency hum and subtle electronic hiss are audible in the background."}, {"id": "330", "observation": "A rhythmic metallic clanking and scraping sound is audible, followed by a deep, resonant roar and a sudden, high-pitched electronic beep."}, {"id": "345", "observation": "A dramatic orchestral score with impactful sound effects and a brief electronic beep accompanies the dialogue."}, {"id": "360", "observation": "A deep, resonant musical drone underlies the scene, punctuated by a sudden, loud metallic crash and a high-pitched, distressed scream."}]
